text:
maya: Quick heads-up — proposal to switch to namespace-scoped API keys so teams can have per-project quotas without customer-level tokens.

dan: How would that map to existing org/project quotas? We need backward compatibility for current keys.

maya: Plan A: accept both for 6 months. New keys default to namespace scope and have explicit quota_id. Old keys map to org-root quota.

sophia: Concern: telemetry will break if we lose key->project mapping. Can we tag old keys with inferred project via last-used metadata?

kevin: We can add a migration job that scans usage traces and assigns a best-effort project tag. It should be opt-in per org. Also add "key_migrated":true flag.

anika: UX question — in console, how do we show keys? Current list is flat. I'd like a column for scope and quota. Maybe a filter for "unscoped" keys that need migration.

maya: Agreed. Proposal for console rows: Name | Key ID | Scope (org/project) | Quota | Last used | Actions. Actions: migrate, rotate, revoke.

dan: For API surface: keep /keys endpoint but accept optional query param ?scope=namespace. Create new POST /keys with "scope":"namespace" field. Backcompat tokens return a warning header: X-Key-Scope: org.

sophia: Telemetry: add fields to our logs: key_scope, quota_id, migrated_by_job. Also emit a metric counter key_migration_attempts{status=success|fail}.

kevin: Canary plan: deploy authz-change behind feature flag. Canary 5% of requests, fallback if error rate > 0.5% or latency +50ms.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: auth-service v2 on infra-us-west at 2025-06-15T09:00Z for 2h :rocket:

anika: One more: rotation UX — when user rotates a key, offer to create new key with same scope and transfer quotas/roles automatically.

maya: Good call. Also add audit log entries for migrate/rotate with operator identity. We should document migration in migration.md and run customer comms for org admins.

dan: I'll sketch the API changes and non-breaking headers. @kevin can you build the migration job prototype? :eyes: 

kevin: Yep, I'll put a draft PR by EOD and include telemetry hooks.

sophia: I'll update docs and console mockups. Let's sync tomorrow 11am to sign off.

maya: Awesome — thanks team. :thumbsup:
